title: Paper Boats
style: English, soft piano pop, warm female vocal, acoustic piano, round bass, light drums, singable melody, relaxed phrasing, 92 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Folded notes in a paper boat
Sent them down where the gutters flow
Every word that I never said
Floating out to the river bed

[Chorus]
Carry it home, carry it slow
Let the water know what I know
If you find it under the bridge
Read it once and let it go
